verdict.rationale: New Relic AI lets users troubleshoot issues and explore telemetry in plain language, and AI insights summarize workload health and potential issues. Together these imply AI-assisted investigation, but nothing explicitly documents the AI taking an alert or error and proposing a probable root cause. The CVE-triage agent shows a similar analysis pattern, but only for vulnerabilities. Missing for 10: explicit docs on AI investigation of alerts/errors, root-cause hypothesis output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
